title: Heimdall Lite
summary: A laptop-based detection lab that compares Suricata rules with a Random Forest model on malware traffic: botnet C2 beaconing, port scans, SSH brute force, and host sweeps.
contributions: Wrote custom Suricata rules.
Engineered flow features for the Random Forest model.
Added Discord alerting in both replay and live modes.

title: Menara
tagline: Agentic IoT system that watches a rooftop garden and acts on it safely.
summary: An end-to-end monitoring and automation system for rooftop gardens in tropical microclimates like Jakarta. ESP32 sensor nodes track soil moisture, temperature, humidity, and light. An agentic AI pipeline evaluates each plant zone using live readings, BMKG weather forecasts, and agronomic thresholds, explains its findings in plain language, and issues low-risk irrigation actions behind strict deterministic guardrails.
contributions: Built the AI module: a deterministic rule engine, linear moisture-depletion forecasting, and LLM plain-language advice checked by guardrails and fallback templates.
Designed the FastAPI backend: sensor ingestion, scheduled zone evaluation, BMKG weather caching, and REST APIs.

title: Tambak
tagline: AI decision support for biofloc aquaculture.
summary: An AI-powered platform that helps biofloc fish farmers read their pond and decide what to do next.
contributions: Designed and developed the complete backend system, including API architecture and implementation.
Implemented API endpoints to handle data processing and communication between the frontend and AI prediction system.
Developed Random Forest regression models and predictive analytics.
Implemented pond health scoring and harvest forecasting.
Built personalised feeding, dosing, and stocking recommendation features.

title: ISYARA
summary: A two-way communication bridge for BISINDO, Indonesian sign language. Signs from the camera become Indonesian text and spoken voice using YOLO11 word detection with a MediaPipe overlay. Spoken Indonesian becomes text through Whisper. The MVP is deliberately limited to word-level signs and reports 'model unavailable' instead of faking predictions.
contributions: Led the UI/UX and frontend of the translator web app.
Built a design system: pink-brown palette, Poppins, Material Symbols hand icons, and pill buttons.
Designed the fullscreen camera translator and a bento-grid landing page with a mascot video.
Built the floating ISYAR-AI chatbot widget (Groq API).

title: Freedge
tagline: Smart fridge inventory with expiry tracking and AI recipes.
summary: A full-stack web app that tracks what is in your fridge, warns before items expire, and suggests recipes with AI.
contributions: Built the RESTful APIs as main backend developer.
Deployed on the university lab server with Cloudflare Tunnel and PM2.

title: Glamour Groove
summary: A dating simulation game with a Java client and a Spring Boot backend that keeps player progress.
contributions: Designed a scalable architecture with Observer, State, Factory, and Singleton patterns.
Built NPC interaction, an auto-save system, and persistent player data.

title: Edventure
tagline: AI matching for scholarships, internships, and competitions.
summary: A platform that matches students to opportunities based on their profile and CV.
contributions: Built the database and backend with Firebase and Qdrant, together with the team.
Implemented CV analysis.
Implemented a real-time recommendation engine with intelligent filtering.

title: AI-Powered Smart IoT System
summary: An IoT system where an ESP32 talks to OpenAI, and an ESP32-CAM detects objects with YOLO.
contributions: Integrated the OpenAI API with ESP32 for AI-driven control and responses.
Ran YOLO-based object detection on ESP32-CAM and stored results in MongoDB Atlas.
Built a real-time monitoring dashboard with Streamlit and Ubidots using ultrasonic, DHT11, and soil moisture sensors.

title: Competition robots, KRI (KRTMI)
summary: Robots built for the national robotics contest, competing against 300+ teams.
contributions: Assisted in developing SCARA-based and ferris-wheel mechanism robots with actuators.
Designed and fabricated robot structures from metal, with 3-wheel and mecanum drive systems.
Modelled parts and ran stress analysis in Autodesk Inventor.
